name: featured2-grid
title: Featured2 Grid
description: Inspired by the air.inc website design — a frosted-glass bento grid floating over a looping sky video. Seven cards across a 12-column layout (7/5, then 5/7, then a 3-up row) each use backdrop-filter with a light-catching top gradient so the moving clouds read straight through them. Artwork bleeds past the card padding to the bottom edge, and the three closing cards are text-only. Collapses to a single stacked column below 1100px.
